name: Plaid
description: Connect your banks and query balances, transactions, investments, and loans with your own Plaid credentials.
installationSteps: Install this plugin, then ask a Bot to set up Plaid on your connected computer or its Linux computer.
Provide your own Plaid credentials through secure input on that computer. Production access is required for real banks.
Ask to connect a bank and complete Plaid Link yourself, then try a balance or transaction query.
Uninstalling the plugin removes its skills; the separately installed CLI, credentials, and bank connections require separate cleanup.

skills.name: plaid-setup
skills.description: Set up Plaid: choose a computer, install the official CLI, and configure your own credentials and environment.

skills.name: plaid-connections
skills.description: Connect a bank through Plaid Link, list bank connections and accounts, or remove a selected connection.

skills.name: plaid-financial-data
skills.description: Query and summarize Plaid balances, transactions, investments, or liabilities for connected accounts.

skills.name: plaid-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose Plaid CLI setup, credential, product-access, or bank connection errors.
